body.objective: After the quartic calibration/redshift disposition, build the first exact observer-response crosswalk that lets a reader trace certified Einstein-image, additional-Weyl and Maxwell residuals into relational detector records without conflating distinct backgrounds or completion choices.
body.stop_condition: When pulled, import the terminal observer-quartic-calibration-relational-redshift-disposition certificate and its exact action, clock, rod, emitter, receiver and detector hashes. Join those data only to residual-atlas rows whose theory, background, harmonic labels, charge sector and lifecycle match exactly. For every matched Einstein-image, additional-Weyl and Maxwell direction, compute the gauge-reduced linear response and every certified same-action nonlinear correction, then classify rank, kernel, blind directions, causal support, K_Berger covariance and dependence on quartic calibration moduli. Prove which distinctions between branches are observable on the declared laboratory and which remain undefined because no background/branch dictionary exists. If the available relational apparatus cannot consume the residual atlas without changing background or action, certify the exact missing morphism rather than fabricating a cross-laboratory identification. Land a machine-readable observer-response atlas fragment, exact certificates, an independent verifier, branch-exchange and gauge/rod mutations, and scoped Paper 09 and public-atlas dispositions.
body.current_gate: an exact same-background residual-mode-to-relational-observation crosswalk, or the first certified obstruction to defining one
body.forbid: no identification of modes across distinct model universes without an explicit certified map; no coordinate-frequency ratio called an observable; no external prescribed apparatus called relational; no completion-dependent response called universal; no raw-D statement where only K_Berger acts; no detector rank inferred from a selected submatrix; no missing nonlinear row filled by analogy; no particle, positivity, phenomenology, black-hole, scattering or unitarity promotion
activates: a branch-resolved observational column in the residual atlas
a precise statement of which extra classical directions the Berger apparatus can distinguish
or a typed cross-background morphism request for the Classical or Bridge stream
body.resource_hint: SECOND OBSERVER RESERVE. Pull only after observer-quartic-calibration-relational-redshift-disposition. Reuse its single action-derived apparatus and report unavailable joins as typed missing maps.
notes: The atlas is useful only if the same mode labels can be followed through pairing, nonlinear constraints and observation; this item owns the observation column, not the underlying branch classification.
A certified absence of a same-background dictionary is a legitimate terminal obstruction and should become a routed request rather than an informal comparison.
This item is input-pinned rather than dependency-gated so an OBSTRUCTED predecessor cannot strand the resident Observer stream; lexical work-pull order places it after the existing quartic successor.
